text:
olivia: Heads-up: scheduling infra apply for release v2.3 at 02:30 UTC. Scope: provider pin, IAM role rotate, two route-table edits. Need manual hold between IAM and traffic-shift.

raj: sequence?

olivia: plan: 1) pin provider to 1.2.3, 2) apply module.iam_roles, 3) wait 5m for token TTL, 4) apply module.route_add, 5) 15m 20% canary, 6) apply module.route_shift, 7) smoke tests then release.

marta: oncall +1 for window. set paging to @oncall for sev2.

sec: ran iam-lint & policy-diff: no PassRole, no wildcard principals. posted summary.

deploybot: queued jobs: plan-13021 (infra/terraform@release/v2.3), apply-13022 (module.iam_roles), apply-13023 (module.route_add), apply-13024 (module.route_shift). Manual holds between 13022->13023 and 13023->13024. Reply `approve <id>` to proceed.

raj: i'll run apply-13022 at start and paste output.

raj: apply-13022: "Apply complete: 3 added, 0 changed, 0 destroyed"  IAM rotated.

olivia: waiting 5m for caches. snapshotting tfstate to s3://tfstate/snapshots/infra-v2.3-preapply.tfstate.

deploybot: apply-13023 awaiting `approve 13023`.

marta: route_add applied: "Apply complete: 2 added, 1 changed"  starting 20% canary for 15m. watching /health and traces.

raj: provider pinned to 1.2.3 in root module and lockfile updated.

marta: canary stable 12m -> recommend proceed.

olivia: approve 13024.

deploybot: apply-13024 started by raj. logs: "applying module.route_shift... Apply complete: 0 added, 2 changed, 0 destroyed"

raj: smoke: `curl -fsS https://api.prod/health | jq .status` -> "ok". No 5xx during canary.

chris: saw a short 503 spike for ~30s at t+90s during route_shift, recovered. capturing for postmortem.

olivia: rollback quick steps for runbook:
```
# revert traffic weights
kubectl annotate svc my-api traffic-weight=0 --overwrite
# revert tf
git checkout <preapply-sha> && terraform apply -auto-approve -target=module.route_shift
# restore tfstate if TF errors
aws s3 cp s3://tfstate/snapshots/infra-v2.3-preapply.tfstate ./terraform.tfstate
```

sec: S3/KMS dry-restore validated in staging.

olivia: publishing release note: "v2.3 infra: provider pinned to 1.2.3; IAM role rotations; staged route updates with canary; no privilege increases." Closing thread.
